back_translation: The sin of Judah is engraved with an iron pen, with a point of diamond, inscribed on the tablet of their hearts and on the horns of your altars.
Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles beside the green trees on the high hills.
O my mountain in the open country, your wealth and all your treasures I will give as plunder, along with your high places, because of sin throughout all your borders.
You will let the inheritance that I gave you slip from your hand, and I will make you serve your enemies in a land you do not know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger; it will burn forever.
Thus says the LORD: Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and whose heart turns away from the LORD.
He will be like a shrub in the parched land, and will not see when good comes. He will dwell in the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land where no one lives.
But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, who has the LORD as his confidence.

He will be like a tree planted by water that sends out its roots along the stream. It will not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves will always be green; in a year of drought it will not be anxious, nor cease to bear fruit.
The heart is a deceiver above all things, and desperately corrupt; who can understand it?
I, the LORD, search the heart and test the inner being, to repay each one according to his ways, according to the fruit of his deeds.
As a partridge broods over eggs it did not lay, so is the man who gets wealth unjustly; in the middle of his days his riches will desert him, and in the end he will be a fool.
A glorious throne, exalted on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be put to shame; those who turn away from you will be written in the dust, for they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living water.
Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for you are my praise.
Behold, they keep saying to me, 'Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now!'
But I have not hurried away from being a shepherd following you, nor have I desired the day of despair. You know that what came from my lips was before your face.
Do not become a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster.

Let my persecutors be put to shame, but do not let me be put to shame; let them be dismayed, but do not let me be dismayed. Bring upon them the day of disaster, and shatter them with double destruction.
Thus the LORD said to me: Go and stand at the gate of the people, through which the kings of Judah enter and go out, and at all the gates of Jerusalem.
And say to them: Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem who enter through these gates.
Thus says the LORD: Take heed for your lives; do not carry a load on the Sabbath day, or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.
Do not carry a load out of your houses on the Sabbath day, and do not do any work, but keep the Sabbath day holy, just as I commanded your forefathers.
But they would not listen or incline their ear; instead they stiffened their necks in stubbornness, so as not to listen or receive discipline.
And if you diligently listen to me, declares the LORD, by not bringing a load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and by keeping the Sabbath day holy, doing no work on it,

then kings and princes who sit on the throne of David will enter through the gates of this city, riding in chariots and on horses—they and their officials, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—and this city will be inhabited forever.

And people will come from the cities of Judah, from around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the Shephelah, from the hill country, and from the Negev, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, grain offerings, and frankincense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the LORD.

But if you do not listen to me to keep the Sabbath day holy, but still carry a load while entering the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will consume the citadels of Jerusalem and will not be quenched.
